passages.text: Over RCA₀, the supplied-rate reconstruction WRμ is provable, whereas the rate-free assertion WR is equivalent to ACA₀. RCA means Recursive Comprehension Axiom; ACA means Arithmetical Comprehension Axiom. They name mathematical axiom systems used to calibrate the two assertions, not levels of physical accuracy.

passages.text: For rational mean-zero chiral step-pair inputs with an ordinary-Cauchy promise, the specified fast polygonal output principle WR is equivalent to ACA₀ over RCA₀. With a supplied tail modulus, WRμ is provable in the base. This is second-order pointwise existence, supported by an infinite written argument and exact finite reduction checks, not a uniform higher-type operator theorem.
